purpose: Final-verification re-run of the nine REAL pm6-build checkers against a u11-substituted candidate built from the CURRENT concept, with an unmodified CONTROL through the identical path. Supersedes the 2026-08-17 audit run and the first remediation run for the port-readiness verdict.

method.why_a_scratch_tree: assemble.py hardcodes PARTS = HERE/"parts" (assemble.py:23), so a substituted part set cannot be fed to the repo copy without writing into Concepts/pm6-build/parts/. The whole pm6-build tree was copied into the scratchpad, the parts substituted there, and the SCRATCH assemble.py run with --gate g2 --out pointing into the scratchpad.
method.gate_used: g2 only. --gate g3 was never invoked.
method.repo_write_proof: git status --porcelain over Concepts/pm6-build/ reports no modification from this probe; Concepts/pm6-build/manifest.json still lists 54 parts. The repo build tree was never written.

variants.base: byte copy of Concepts/pm6-build with no substitutions - the CONTROL. base.assembled.html sha256 prefix 3d82a850dad0e412 matches build_pm7.py BASE_SHA, so the control is the pinned base exactly.
variants.cand-A: the port handoff proposal (PORT_HANDOFF_PM7_BUILD_ROUTE.md sec 1.2/1.3 as corrected by HANDOFF_CORRECTIONS.md): parts 15/27/47 substituted, new part slots created, _shared/usage-chrome.js NOT ported. 61 parts.
variants.cand-B: cand-A plus _shared/usage-chrome.js in its own script part - the naive straight port. 62 parts.

known_deviations_from_the_handoff: Icons were given their own balanced script part (29x-pm6-js-usage-icons.part.html) instead of being folded into the PM_ICONS hoist in 29x-pm6-js-globals.part.html, so the substitution stays purely additive and auditable. Effect: one extra balanced-zero advisory in check_structure and one extra script block in the check_js count. No gate verdict changes.
Part 47 (the PM_DEMO bridge) was left byte-unchanged. Rewriting it is design work, not a measurable transform, and no checker reads it semantically.
Part 18 unlabeled <style> emitted as the handoff documented stub. This is the configuration that MAXIMISES the check_css raw-hex finding count, i.e. the conservative measurement.
method.inherited_from: The same setup_candidate.py / run_gates.py used by the first remediation pass, re-pointed at a fresh scratch root so the earlier run remains intact for comparison.
